name: Enable NumLock on Startup
description: Enables NumLock automatically on startup and at the Windows sign-in screen, so your numeric keypad is ready to use immediately.

description_i18n.en: Enables NumLock automatically on startup and at the Windows sign-in screen, so your numeric keypad is ready to use immediately.
description_i18n.de: Aktiviert den Ziffernblock automatisch beim Start und auf dem Anmeldebildschirm von Windows, damit die Tastatur sofort einsatzbereit ist.
description_i18n.fr: Active automatiquement NumLock au démarrage et sur l'écran de connexion Windows afin que le pavé numérique soit disponible immédiatement.

warnings.title: BIOS Override Risk
warnings.message: Some systems with Fast Startup or BIOS-level NumLock settings may override this tweak until you perform a full restart of the computer

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Updates the InitialKeyboardIndicators registry value for both the current user and the default logon profile to ensure consistent behavior
